statements.english: As far as I'm concerned, the practice of killing rare wild animals for food and money is utterly abhorrent and should be punished by law.

statements.chinese: 把...强加给，使遭受，使承受

statements.english: Government's fiscal policy will be tilting toward agricultural development.

statements.english: What's even worse, they will transmit many diseases.

statements.chinese: 冒犯的；使人不快的；无礼的；攻击性的，进攻性的

statements.english: The majority of people maintain that mass media has no rights to report the extravagant lifestyle and privacy of a star.

statements.chinese: 大部分接受调查的公民争论道，政府残忍地无视他们的基本人权。
statements.english: Most of the surveyed citizens argued that the government had shown a ruthless disregard for their basic human rights.

statements.chinese: 在做有关某一特定领域的报告时，为避免听众产生疑惑和不解，你应该尽量少用术语。
statements.english: If you take a presentation on some specific fields, to avoid confusing the audience, you should try to decrease jargon in your speech.

statements.chinese: 数百万年前，地球气候的变化导致了这片热带雨林物种的多样性。
statements.english: Millions of years ago, changes in the Earth's climate gave rise to diverse species in the tropical rain forest.

statements.chinese: 这里是非吸烟区，请将所有香烟熄灭。
statements.english: This is non-smoking section. Please extinguish all cigarettes.

statements.english: If the government continues to increase the tax, it will estrange itself from the public in the end.

statements.chinese: 除了规模的宏伟和几何形状的简洁性外，使用圆柱也是新古典建筑的标志性特征。
statements.english: Besides grandeur of scale and simplicity of geometric forms, the use of columns is also the representative feature of neoclassical architecture.

statements.chinese: 妈妈们可能有些偏颇，她们总是认为自己的孩子是世界上最棒的。
statements.english: Mothers might be biased to always think their children are the best in the world.

statements.chinese: 日益严重的空气污染正威胁着生活于肮脏的工业城市中的人们的健康。
statements.english: The increasingly serious air pollution is threatening the health of people living in the grimy industrial cities.

statements.chinese: 尽管不是所有人都喜欢洋葱、姜、蒜的味道，但它们都具有极佳的增强免疫的功能。
statements.english: Although not all people like the flavor of onion, ginger or garlic, they are good immune system enhancer.

statements.chinese: 较远的；不可告人的，隐秘的，秘密的

statements.english: In current society, when one actively supports someone who needs help, he may be suspected of having an ulterior motive by some people.

statements.chinese: 腐化，腐蚀；使堕落；破坏，损坏；（计算机文件等）出错
严格的，苛刻的；紧缩的，短缺的；迫切的
严格的安保制度确保了奥运会的成功举办。
statements.english: A stringent regulation on security has guaranteed the success of Olympic Games.

statements.chinese: 生手，新手；初学者；新信徒，初学修士（或修女）
2001年，作为WTO的新成员，中国面临着许多不同的机遇和挑战。
statements.english: In 2001, China, a novice in WTO, had many different opportunities and challenges to face.

statements.chinese: 调查显示，大部分求职者因缺乏相关的工作经验而导致其工作申请受阻。
statements.english: The survey reveals that most of the candidates' job applications have been hindered by their lack of relevant working experience.

statements.chinese: 穷困的，赤贫的；贫乏的，贫瘠的；枯竭的
过度耕作已经造成了大量土地的贫瘠，所以必须实行退耕还林。
statements.english: It is necessary to carry out the project of returning farmland to forests since overfarming has created much impoverished soil.

statements.chinese: 淹没，泛滥；使不胜负荷，使应接不暇
由于连降大雨，尼罗河大坝溃堤，淹没了该镇的大部分地区和农田。
statements.english: Due to the successive heavy rain, the dam of the Nile breaks, which inundates large parts of the town and farmlands.

statements.chinese: 过去几个月食品价格大幅上涨，削弱了公众对政府政策的信心。
statements.english: The sharp increase in food price over the last few months has eroded the public's confidence in the government's policy.

statements.chinese: 注定...失败（或遭殃、死亡等），使...在劫难逃；毁灭；厄运，劫数
一些人认为，如果这种珍稀动物得不到很好的保护，它注定会灭绝。
statements.english: Some people hold that if this kind of rare animal is not well protected, it will be doomed to extinction.

statements.chinese: 使疏远，使不友好；转让，让渡（财产等）
天才出众的人可能觉得与大众格格不入。
statements.english: Very talented people may feel alienated from the public.

statements.chinese: 黄铜制的，黄铜色的；厚颜无耻的

statements.english: How can you believe such a brazen lie?

statements.chinese: 那个部落的人过去常认为陆龟和海龟来自地狱。
statements.english: People in that tribe used to think that the tortoises and turtles came from hell.

statements.chinese: 我们对那些失去工作的求职者深表同情。
statements.english: We deeply commiserated with job hunters who were on the loss of their jobs.

statements.chinese: 亡命之徒，逃犯，被剥夺法律权益者
到目前为止，事实证明该政府试图使酒后驾车成为非法行为的努力失败了。
statements.english: So far, the government's attempt to outlaw drunken driving has proved to be unsuccessful.

statements.chinese: 据报道，30％的毕业生要花大约四个月的时间四处奔波寻找一份工作。
statements.english: According to the report, 30% of graduates will spend about four months pounding the pavement in search of a job.

statements.chinese: 据调查，由于装饰品的大量需求，近几年深海珊瑚数量锐减。
statements.english: According to the research, with a big requirement of decoration, there is a falling number of coral in deep ocean in recent years.

statements.chinese: 火山附近村子里的数百名居民在岩浆喷发产生的高温中化为灰烬。
statements.english: Hundreds of residents in the village near the volcano were incinerated by the high temperatures generated by the eruption of magma.

statements.chinese: 可更新的，可再生的，可恢复的；可延长有效期的，可续期的

statements.english: Scientists all over the world have made utmost efforts to develop renewable energy sources such as wind and tide power.

statements.chinese: 当有陌生人试图对你性骚扰的时候，应该毫无畏惧地打他的鼻子踢他的小腿。
statements.english: You should punch him in the nose and kick him in the shins without fear when a stranger tries to sexually harass you.

statements.chinese: 如今，越来越多的美国人意识到了自己正沦为信用卡债务的奴隶。
statements.english: Nowadays, more and more Americans have realized that they are being enslaved by the credit-card debt.

statements.chinese: 一般而言，动物园的动物比森林中的野生动物胆小谨慎。
statements.english: Generally speaking, animals in the zoo are timid and cautious in comparison with wild animals in the forest.

statements.chinese: 糟糕透顶的，可恶的；恶劣的，卑鄙的

statements.english: Study shows that children who live in violent surroundings may use more vile languages than ordinary children.

statements.chinese: 由于新能源的开发，柴油机在日常生活中的使用日益减少。
statements.english: Because of the development of new energies, less and less diesel engines are used in daily life.

statements.chinese: 由于其生产的汽车耗油量太大，该汽车公司近几年的销售量一直在下滑。
statements.english: As its cars guzzle fuel, this car company has decreasing sales figures in recent years.

statements.chinese: 痛苦，折磨；令人痛苦的东西

statements.english: In recent years, the government has encouraged folk artists to revive traditional skills by funding them.

statements.chinese: 不近人情的，残忍的，不人道的

statements.english: Some people think that the government's housing policy now might imperil the whole real estate market.

statements.english: The animal protectors consider the idea of killing wild animals for pleasure extremely barbaric.

statements.english: Since 911, American government has promised to take tough measures to retaliate against the terrorists.

statements.english: Nowadays, there is a common phenomenon in society that more and more criminals make use of new scientific technologies to perpetrate crimes.

statements.english: When a ship anchors, it means sailors can stay in the town for a short time to live as locals.

statements.english: If human beings continue to despoil the natural resources crazily, they will be doomed to be punished by nature.

statements.english: Much to our surprise, some companies have been lax in carrying out their social responsibilities.

statements.chinese: 使增长，使兴旺；鼓励，促进；为...作宣传，宣扬

statements.english: Apparently, stock prices were boosted by the President's recovery report and supportive policies from the government.

statements.chinese: 胡乱涂抹；弄脏，弄污；诽谤，诋毁；变得模糊不清，把（图画等）弄得模糊不清

statements.english: Under the new law, Internet bars must enact relevant policies to prevent young people's admission.

statements.english: The elder sisters in the family would resent all the attention that the coming baby was getting, especially when it was a little brother.

statements.chinese: 有些人可能生于富裕之家，但却往往不知道如何利用其先天优势来创造一个令人称羡的生活或是珍惜所拥有的一切。

statements.english: Scientists have found that tillable lands have declined sharply in recent years due to global warming.

statements.chinese: 一旦草地遭到过度放牧，就会导致植被受损，土壤易于流失。
statements.english: Once the grass land is overgrazed, the vegetation will be damaged and the ground will become liable to erosion.

statements.chinese: （作品等）表达，体现；具体表现，使具体化；包括，包含
通常，如果你想写出好文章，你最好列举一些体现文章主旨的相关例子。
statements.english: As a rule, if you want to write a good essay, you'd better list some relevant examples embodying the gist.

statements.chinese: 一般而言，人们以前受过别人恩惠，他们会进行报答。
statements.english: Generally speaking, people will reciprocate the kindness that have been shown to them before.

statements.chinese: 垂死的，即将灭亡的；即将结束的
眼下的一个大难题是世界经济如何从行将就木的状态中走向复苏。
statements.english: There is a big problem at present that how the world economy can be revived from its present moribund state.

statements.chinese: 隔离的，分离的；与世隔绝的，偏僻的；孤立的，孤独的；个别的
老年人很容易变成与社会脱节的一个群体，所以他们应该不断前进并保持与外界的互动。
statements.english: Old people could easily become a socially isolated group, so they should keep moving and maintain interaction with the outside world.

statements.chinese: 如今，一个有趣的现象是一些过去的时尚再度流行开来，如迷你裙。
statements.english: Nowadays, there is an interesting phenomenon that some bygone fashions, such as mini-skirt, become modish again.

statements.chinese: 政府有必要制定相关法律来惩罚虐待家养动物的人。
statements.english: It is necessary for the government to make relevant laws to punish people who maltreat domestic animals.

statements.chinese: 在与家人分离的近半个世纪中，老一辈一直怀念着自己的家。
statements.english: The old generation had been pining for home since the separation with families nearly half a century ago.

statements.chinese: 在中国，孩子通常不能违抗父母之命，但在美国却不然。
statements.english: In China, children usually cannot disobey the orders of their parents, but it is not the same situation in America.

statements.chinese: 由于天气潮湿、没有光照，河边的石头很容易长青苔。
statements.english: Due to the moist weather without sunlight, the rocks near the river were easily covered with moss.

statements.chinese: 多才多艺的，多面手的；多用途的，通用的
蜂蜜具有多种功能，价格不贵，被广泛应用于日常生活的各个方面。
statements.english: Because honey is versatile and not expensive, it is widely used in every aspect of our daily life.

statements.chinese: 对某个人或某件事记仇会耗费一个人的精力，到最后一无所获。
statements.english: Owing a grudge against somebody or something consumes one's energies and finally accomplishes nothing at all.

statements.chinese: 自命不凡的，自负的；炫耀的；做作的
该作者写了一篇书评，言语间满是自负，表达了相当偏执的评论意见。
statements.english: The writer took a book review in pretentious language to express his biased criticism.

statements.chinese: 征募；从军，参军；谋取（帮助、支持等）
目前，正在全国范围内招募成千上万的志愿者，为即将到来的世博会服务。
statements.english: At present, tens of thousands of volunteers are being enlisted all over the country to serve the approaching World Expo.

statements.chinese: 对于同性恋结婚是否合法的问题，还需进一步探讨。
statements.english: Whether homosexuals could get married legally or not needs further elaboration.

statements.chinese: 势利的，谄上欺下的；自命不凡的
在当今社会，有些人非常势利，他们只愿意与有钱和社会地位高的人交朋友。
statements.english: In current society, some people are very snobbish, who'd like to make friends only with people of wealth and of high social status.

statements.chinese: 磁铁，磁石；磁体；有吸引力的人或物
巴黎一直扮演着一个磁铁一样的角色，不断吸引着想要寻找浪漫和真爱的人们。
statements.english: Paris has always played a role of a magnet to attract people to seek romance and true love.

statements.chinese: 过去常常烦扰老年人的颈椎病现在盛行于年轻的上班族之中。
statements.english: The illness on neck, which used to bother the elderly, is of prevalence among young office workers nowadays.

statements.chinese: 寒冷的，阴沉的；阴郁的，暗淡的；没有希望的，不乐观的；荒凉的；索然无味的
据报道，由于金融危机，很多美国人在去年的圣诞节遭遇财政寒冬。
statements.english: It's reported that many Americans faced a financially bleak Christmas last year because of the financial crisis.

statements.chinese: 黄道面与赤道面之间有一个夹角被称为黄赤交角。
statements.english: There is an angle between the ecliptic plane and the equatorial plane which is called the obliquity of the ecliptic.

statements.chinese: 罪恶的，邪恶的；残酷的，残忍的；凶猛的；恶性的
一群旅游者遭到一帮当地流氓的恶意攻击。
statements.english: A group of tourists suffered a vicious attack by a gang of local people.

statements.chinese: 对...感到不满；嫉妒；勉强做，不乐意地做
那些发现自己的收入大幅减少的富人对与穷人分享收益表示不满。
statements.english: The rich, who saw their income slashed, did begrudge sharing their gains with the poor.

statements.chinese: 散布，传播；（光等）漫射；（使气体或液体）扩散，弥漫
如今，因特网已取代电视成为传播知识和信息的有力媒介。
statements.english: Nowadays, Internet has become a powerful means of diffusing knowledge and information instead of television.

statements.chinese: 只有受过教育的人才是自由的。——古希腊哲学家 爱比克泰德（Epictetus, Ancient Greek philosopher）

packs.title: IELTS 高频听力词汇
packs.description: 社区整理的 IELTS 高频听力词汇；为便于练习，每课最多 50 条。 来源：https://github.com/Huhua-Xiao/easy-language

statements.chinese: 水电煤气等公共设施费
提供床铺和早餐的旅店
有多个播放屏幕的电影院
对学生的学习情况进行评估
体形像熊的澳大利亚有袋动物
仔兽;幼狐;小熊;(狼,虎等的)仔

statements.english: be on the corner of ...street and …street
be the first from the left

packs.title: IELTS 句子翻译练习
packs.description: 社区整理的 IELTS 中英文句子翻译练习；每课 35 条。 来源：https://github.com/Huhua-Xiao/easy-language

statements.chinese: 经常参加体育活动能够提高人们的自信心，这不但对年轻人而且对老人很重要。
statements.english: Participating in sports activities regularly can boost people's confidence, which is important not only to the youth but also to the elderly.

statements.chinese: 教学的质量对学生成绩有很大的影响。
statements.english: The quality of teaching has a significant impact on students' performance.

statements.chinese: 教学的质量被认为是决定学生成绩的关键，因此，家长喜欢为孩子选择名校。
statements.english: The quality of teaching is considered crucial for determining students' performance, therefore, parents prefer to choose prestigious schools for children.

statements.chinese: 家长和老师应该努力去减少孩子看电视的时间，这样会保护孩子的视力，鼓励他们做户外运动。
statements.english: Parents and teachers should strive to reduce the time children spend watching TV, as this will protect their eyesight and encourage them to engage in outdoor activities.

statements.chinese: 经济下滑已经导致失业率上升，因为人们对开展新失业犹豫。
statements.english: Economic slowdown has led to a climbing unemployment rate, as people balk at starting up new businesses and a number of giant companies downsize their workforce.

statements.chinese: 一个国家的经济发展依靠一定量的年轻劳动力，但是问题是老龄化的社会对劳动力有负面影响。
statements.english: A country's economic development relies on a supply of young workers, but the problem is that the aging society has an adverse impact on the labour force.

statements.chinese: 人们工作负担重，没有足够的时间休息，这可能对他们的健康有害。
statements.english: People with a heavy workload do not have adequate time to rest, which can be harmful to their fitness.

statements.chinese: 在中国，很多学生晚上都要自习
statements.english: Many students in China have to study at night.

statements.chinese: 在中国，许多学生都要在晚上自学，所以课外活动不得不给学习让路。
statements.english: A large number of students in China have to do self-study at night, so extra-curricular activities have to give way to studies.

statements.chinese: 城市的发展已经威胁到历史遗迹，但是政府还没有办法是否去保护还是毁坏这些建筑。
statements.english: The development of cities has posed a threat to heritage sites, but the government has no idea whether to protect or demolish these constructions.

statements.chinese: 网络能够丰富我们的生活，但是我们不应该忽视面对面的交流因为它对社会关系有直接影响。
statements.english: Internet can enrich our social lives, but we should not ignore face-to-face communication, because this has a direct impact on social relationships.

statements.chinese: 一些公共服务很难收支平衡，需要政府资金。
statements.english: Some public services have problems in breaking even and need government funds.

statements.chinese: 我们需要考虑社会和经济的环境
statements.english: We need to consider the social and economic environment.

statements.chinese: 当分析青少年犯罪的根本原因的时候，我们应该考虑社会和经济环境。
statements.english: We have to consider the social and economic context when analysing the root causes of juvenile delinquency.

statements.chinese: 密度种植对生物多样性造成了威胁。
statements.english: Density planting poses a threat to biodiversity.

statements.chinese: 密集种植对野生植物有巨大影响，对物种多样性有巨大威胁。
statements.english: Intensive farming has a seriously negative impact on natural flora, and this may pose a threat to biodiversity.

statements.chinese: 密集种植对天然植物有严重的负面影响，这可能对农业的可持续发展有威胁。
statements.english: Intensive farming has a seriously negative impact on natural flora, and this may pose a threat to sustainable development of agriculture.

statements.chinese: 当地政府应该保证平等教育，这样能够帮助落后学生去解决学习的落后。
statements.english: The local government should ensure equal education, which can help underachieving students tackle their educational underachievement.

statements.chinese: 接触不同的文化可以促进创新
statements.english: Exposure to different cultures can foster innovation.

statements.chinese: 接触不同的文化能够促进创新，这是企业或者国家的财富。
statements.english: Exposure to different cultures can encourage creativity, which is an asset for enterprises or countries.

statements.chinese: 一些人认为政府重视社会福利，尤其是医疗服务，这会帮助弱势群体不再无谓地死去。
statements.english: Some people suggest that the government should give priority to welfare services, especially the healthcare, which helps stop the disadvantaged population dying needlessly.

statements.chinese: 教育或许决定了人的工作机会。
statements.english: Education may hold the key to one’s job prospect.

statements.chinese: 使用化石资源对环境会造成破坏。
statements.english: Using fossil resources can cause damage to the environment.

statements.chinese: 建造住宅楼有助于解决城市的拥挤问题。
statements.english: Building apartment blocks helps solve the crowding problem in cities.

statements.chinese: 住宅楼由于其能最大限度地利用土地和空间，所以有助于解决城市过度拥挤的问题。
statements.english: Apartment blocks, which make the most of land and space, help solve overcrowding in cities.

statements.chinese: 贫穷的人可以通过努力工作来提高社会地位
statements.english: Poor people can improve their social status by working hard.

statements.chinese: 贫穷的人可以通过努力工作来提高社会地位，这看起来是一个辛苦但有效的过程。
statements.english: People from disadvantaged backgrounds can improve their social status by working hard and this seems an arduous but rewarding process.

statements.chinese: 我们需要采取措施去解决一些棘手的问题。
statements.english: We need to take measures to solve some thorny problems.

statements.chinese: 媒体通过夸大受害者的伤痛去吸引观众。
statements.english: Media exaggerate the hurt of victims to attract audience.

statements.chinese: 媒体通过夸大受害者的伤痛去吸引观众，而忽视对这些观众的有害结果，比如将他们在公众面前曝光。
statements.english: The media attracts public attention by sensationalising victims’ suffering, while ignoring harmful consequences to these individuals, such as their exposure to the public.

statements.chinese: 基因工程使人们能培育出抗旱的农作物品种，因此可以提高土地利用率。
statements.english: Genetic engineering allows people to nurture crop varieties that are resistant to drought, thereby improving land productivity.

statements.chinese: 经常做运动帮助人们保持一个健康的心态，是他们更容易应对压力。
statements.english: Doing exercise regularly helps people maintain a healthy state of mind and makes it easier for them to cope with stress.

statements.chinese: 不健康的生活方式让人们处于生病的危险之中。
statements.english: Unhealthy lifestyle is likely to make people at risk of illness.

statements.chinese: 奖学金可以鼓励更多的学生去学习研究生课程。
statements.english: Scholarships can encourage more students to pursue postgraduate studies.

statements.chinese: 社区改造为罪犯提供了获得职业技能的机会
statements.english: Community rehabilitation provides offenders with opportunities to gain vocational skills.

statements.chinese: 社区服务给犯人提供获得实用技能的机会，给他们好的起点当他们被释放后。
statements.english: Community service provides prisoners with the opportunity to gain practical skills and gives them a good start when they are released.

statements.chinese: 乡村地区给人们提供机会去远离现代生活的压力和噪音。
statements.english: Rural areas provide people with opportunities to escape pressure and noises of modern life.

statements.chinese: 乡村地区对人们的健康有益，因为它给人们提供机会去远离现代生活的压力和噪音。
statements.english: Rural areas are beneficial to people's health, providing people with opportunities to escape pressure and noises of modern life.

statements.chinese: 人口老龄化促使国家去提高法定退休年龄。
statements.english: The ageing population has prompted countries to raise the statutory retirement age.

statements.chinese: 人口老龄化导致高级技术工人的短缺，这个问题已经促使国家提高法定退休年龄。
statements.english: The ageing population leads to a shortage of highly skilled workers, a problem which has prompted countries to raise the statutory retirement age.

statements.chinese: 学校应该允许老师强制捣蛋的小孩离开教室。
statements.english: Schools should allow teachers to make the children with disruptive behaviours go out of classrooms.

statements.chinese: 农村的失业问题在某种程度上可以通过城乡转移解决。
statements.english: Unemployment in rural areas can be addressed by rural-to-urban shift.

statements.chinese: 农村失业问题的主要原因是缺少基础建设和政府资助，这个问题在某种程度可以通过城乡转移解决。
statements.english: The lack of infrastructure and government funding in rural areas is the main cause of unemployment, which can be addressed partially by the rural-to-urban shift.

statements.chinese: 学校活动的设置要能让孩子体会到成就感和提升他们的幸福感。
statements.english: The setup of school activities should allow children to experience a sense of achievement and enhance their happiness.

statements.chinese: 好的文章是可读的，内容充实的，而很多同学的问题是比较死板和枯燥地将一些单词放进去。
statements.english: Good articles are readable and substantial, while many students' problems are that they rigidly and dully insert some words.

statements.chinese: 现在公司喜欢能够打破常规的员工。
statements.english: Nowadays, companies prefer those employees who can break the mould.

statements.chinese: 因为堵车上下班时间变得更长。
statements.english: Commuting time has been prolonged because of traffic congestion.

statements.chinese: 学生们可以获得电脑技术，这些技术可以应用在他们的学习和工作中。
statements.english: Students can acquire computer skills which can be applied in their studies as well as their working lives.

statements.chinese: 大部分的环境破坏都可以归咎于人类的活动。
statements.english: Most of environmental degradation is attributed to human activities.

statements.chinese: 很多每天接触暴力内容的孩子容易用暴力，因为他们把暴力当作日常生活的一部分。
statements.english: Many children are exposed to violent content every day and prone to act up, because they treat it as a normal part of everyday life.

statements.chinese: 家庭环境被认为是小孩成长最重要的影响。
statements.english: Family environment is widely thought to be the most important influence on children development.

statements.chinese: 随着越来越多的年轻人参加志愿者工作，社区的凝聚力会加强
statements.english: With more young people joining volunteer work, community cohesion will be enhanced.

statements.chinese: 移民有时候被认为是社会团结的一个威胁。
statements.english: Immigrants are sometimes considered a threat to social cohesion.

statements.chinese: 一个取得广泛共识的概念是没有大学文凭的年轻人通常只能找低技术含量的工作，这也危害到他们的生活质量。
statements.english: A widely accepted concept is that young people without university degrees normally end up working in low-skilled jobs, and this can compromise their quality of life.

statements.chinese: 一些人反对转基因食品，因为他们认为这种食品的弊大于利。
statements.english: Some people disapprove of genetically modified food, as they believe that this type of food does more harm than good.

statements.chinese: 在竞争激烈的社会，有工作的人关心职业发展。
statements.english: In a highly competitive society, working adults usually focus on career advancement.

statements.chinese: 在竞争激烈的社会中，有工作的人关心职业发展，很难实现工作和生活的平衡。
statements.english: In a highly competitive society, working adults usually focus on career advancement, and have difficulty in achieving work-life balance.

statements.chinese: 动物实验有时候不能够检验出药物的不良副作用。
statements.english: Animal experiments sometimes cannot detect the adverse side effects of drugs.

statements.chinese: 非法捕杀导致某些动物的灭亡。
statements.english: Illegal hunting leads to the extinction of some animals.

statements.chinese: 电脑对人的文化程度的影响随着年龄变化，老师对电脑的用法有复杂的感情。
statements.english: The impact of computers on communication skills varies across ages and teachers have mixed feelings on the usage of computers.

statements.chinese: 很多女孩不愿意在男人为大多数的行业找工作，因为她们会面临在高职位升迁中的阻碍。
statements.english: Many girls are reluctant to find employment in a male-dominated world because they can face barriers to top-level promotion.

statements.chinese: 艺术不属于学校的主科。
statements.english: Art is not a main subject in school.

statements.chinese: 虽然艺术不属于学校的主要课程，但是它们在课程大纲里值得拥有一席之地，因为这些科目能够给生活添色彩。
statements.english: The arts are not among core subject areas at school but deserve a place in the curriculum, for these subjects add spice to life.

statements.chinese: 空运可能比其他运输方式产生更多的温室气体。
statements.english: Air freight is likely to create more greenhouse gases than other modes of transport.

statements.chinese: 在家遭受虐待或者忽视的孩子可能会有行为问题。
statements.english: The children who are exposed to abuse or neglect in the home are likely to have behavioural problems.

statements.chinese: 人口的扩大是大量垃圾产生的原因，这些垃圾需要几十年才能降解。
statements.english: Population expansion is the main reason for the huge accumulation of waste, which can take decades to degrade.

statements.chinese: 我们的环境还是很糟糕
statements.english: Our environment is still in a dire state.

statements.chinese: 除非我们的现代生活方式有深远改变，否则我们的环境还是会很糟。
statements.english: Unless we make profound changes in modern lifestyles, our environment will remain in a dire state.
Racial discrimination is still very serious.

statements.chinese: 虽然政府促进平等，但是种族歧视仍然是一个严重问题。
statements.english: Racial discrimination remains a serious problem, although governments promote equality.

statements.chinese: 贫穷国家的首要问题是满足人们基本生存需求。
statements.english: The primary issue for poor countries is meeting people's basic survival needs.

statements.chinese: 基因食物对健康的影响仍然未知，所以清楚的食物标签被强烈提倡。
statements.english: The health effect of GE food remains unclear, so clear food labeling is strongly advocated.

statements.chinese: 网络购物对于很多人已经成为生活中的很普通的一部分。
statements.english: Online shopping has become a very common part of life for many people.

statements.chinese: 在一个消费社会里，人们不再满足生活必需品。
statements.english: In a consumer society, people are no longer satisfied with the bare necessities.

statements.chinese: 人们不健康的生活方式是他们倾向于依赖科技的结果。
statements.english: Unhealthy lifestyle is the result of trend to rely on science and technology.

statements.chinese: 人们不健康的生活方式是他们倾向于依赖科技的结果，尽管事实上科技让他们的生活更加方便，给他们的生活带来很大提高。
statements.english: People’s unhealthy lifestyle is the result of their tendency to rely heavily on technology, despite the fact that technology has made their lives convenient and improved their lives significantly.

statements.chinese: 贫穷是社区犯罪上升的原因。
statements.english: Poverty is responsible for the crime wave in many communities.

statements.chinese: 因为费用的下降，航空最近几十年发展得很快，这意味着人们会比以前更多旅游。
statements.english: The decline in costs has led to rapid development in aviation over the past few decades, which means people are tempted to travel more frequently than before.

statements.chinese: 电子汽车的发明是我们维护环境所做努力的其中一部分。
statements.english: The invention of electric vehicles is a part of our efforts aiming at preserving the environment.

statements.chinese: 电子汽车的发明是我们维护环境所做努力的其中一部分，因为这些汽车比传统汽车产生较少的废气。
statements.english: The invention of electric cars is part of our efforts to sustain the environment because these vehicles create less exhaust fumes than conventional cars.

statements.chinese: 送贵重礼物是一种中国传统，当收到或者送便宜礼物的时候，很多人觉得丢面子。
statements.english: Exchanging lavish gifts is a tradition in China and many people feel they lose face when giving or receiving inexpensive gifts.

statements.chinese: 除非当地政府减少城市扩张对植物的影响，否则在未来几十年里我们会发现保护物种多样性很困难。
statements.english: Unless local authorities reduce the impact of city expansion on vegetation, we will find it difficult to preserve biodiversity in the coming decades.

statements.chinese: 随着年龄的增加，人们发现保持与亲人和朋友的联系变得困难，因为他们被工作和其他任务占据。
statements.english: As people age, they find it difficult to maintain contact with family and friends, as they are occupied with work and other commitments.

statements.chinese: 同意免费大学教育的人们认为该措施会使那些家境不好的学生有同等上大学的机会。
statements.english: People who agree with free university education believe that this practice makes it possible for students from less well-off backgrounds to have equal access to tertiary education.

statements.chinese: 很多人觉得有必要赶时尚；否则的话，他们相信自己过时了。
statements.english: Many people consider it necessary to follow fashion; otherwise, they believe they are behind the times.

statements.chinese: 经费削减让很多年轻人很难接受大学教育。
statements.english: Budget cuts make it difficult for many young people to access higher education.

statements.chinese: 有时候，很难去评估人类行为的环境代价。
statements.english: Sometimes, it is difficult to evaluate the environmental costs of people's behaviors.

statements.chinese: 有时候，虽然很难去评估人类行为的环境代价，但是应该颁布法律以限制这些行为。
statements.english: Sometimes, although it is difficult to evaluate the environmental cost of human activities, it is necessary to enact laws to restrict some behaviours.

statements.chinese: 在大城市有一些贫困的社区。
statements.english: There are some economically deprived communities in large cities.

statements.chinese: 按照能力分班和学生的成绩没有明显的联系。
statements.english: There is no clear link between selection in terms of students' ability and their academic performance.

statements.chinese: 体育课可以促进身体健康，增强信心
statements.english: The PE class can promote physical health and boost confidence.

statements.chinese: 我们应该认识到体育课的重要性，因为它可以促进学生的身心健康，增强他们的自信心。
statements.english: We should recognise the importance of the PE class, as it improves students' physical conditions and boosts their confidence.

statements.chinese: 尽管学术表现被高度重视，但我们不应该忽视学生的身体健康的重要性。
statements.english: While academic performance is highly valued, we should not lose sight of the importance of students' physical condition.

statements.chinese: 在发展中国家开设新的分公司可以降低生产成本,产生巨大的利润
statements.english: Opening new branches in developing countries can reduce the cost of production and earn huge profits.

statements.chinese: 生活方式的轻微变化也能够产生巨大的变化，并且可以减少我们日常活动对环境的影响。
statements.english: The slight changes in lifestyle can also make a huge difference and reduce the impact of our daily activities on the environment.

statements.chinese: 大学生没办法赚到钱即使他们获得文凭。
statements.english: University students cannot earn money even though they have gained qualifications.

statements.chinese: 事实是，一些工作已经被砍掉，因为机械化的原因。
statements.english: The fact is that some jobs have been made redundant because of the mechanization.

statements.chinese: 确实如此，现在很多人选择走向环保和减少能源的使用。
statements.english: The truth is that plenty of people choose to go green and decline the use of energy.

statements.chinese: 我相信快餐广告和肥胖的普遍有直接的联系。
statements.english: I believe there is a direct link between fast food advertising and the prevalence of obesity.

statements.chinese: 政府的资金也可以用于污染清理工作，这可以创造一个舒适的环境。
statements.english: The government's funds can also be used for pollution clean-up work, which can create a comfortable environment.

statements.chinese: 这会有助于提高空气质量，这也降低了一些健康问题的风险，比如呼吸道疾病。
statements.english: This will help improve air quality, which also reduces the risk of some health problems, such as respiratory diseases.

statements.chinese: 当局应该控制这些夸张报道社会问题的新闻。
statements.english: The authorities should control the news that exaggerates social issues.

statements.chinese: 这就是为什么文员（clerical workers）如今经常有健康的问题。
statements.english: This is why clerical workers often have health problems nowadays.

statements.chinese: 许多员工愿意在那些可以获得晋升机会的公司工作。
statements.english: Many employees are willing to work in companies where promotional opportunities are available.

statements.chinese: 很多年轻人选择在英文国家学习，在那里，他们可以在世界著名的大学学习。
statements.english: Many young people have chosen to study in English-speaking countries, where they can study at some world famous universities.
